name: RISD Art Camp (Youth Full-Day Camps)
operator_name: Rhode Island School of Design Continuing Education (RISD CE)
description_short: A week-long, full-day art camp for ages 6–8 and 9–12 at Tillinghast Place in Barrington, RI. Mornings are guided 2D and 3D art lessons, and the day also includes nature walks, outdoor recreation and a Friday art show for families.
activities: Nature walks on the beach and in the woods
special_needs_notes: If a camper needs accommodation for physical, emotional, mental or social needs, families should contact the CE main office before registering so the camp can check whether it can meet those needs. Non-emergency medications cannot be given at camp. Emergency medications must come in their original labeled packaging with a doctor-signed action plan.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers visit the beachfront but do not swim in the water.
